reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was zero reviews, and I don't buy a supplement without hundreds of them. The lab QR and "no oxide" are nice, but any brand can print that, and I'd want to read the 1-star reviews on stomach and capsule size first.
objection: No reviews, so I can't check for stomach upset, pill size or whether the dose is real. A QR code is the brand's own claim, not strangers' experience.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred reviews with a decent share of verified purchases, and 1-star reviews that don't mention stomach trouble or fake dosing.
